english.note: This is the all-purpose word for a shirt collar and also a fabric band forming a garment neckline.

examples.english: The collar on this shirt is too high and presses against my neck.
examples.traditional: 件恤衫個領太高，頂住條頸。
examples.jyutping: gin6 seot1 saam1 go3 leng5 taai3 gou1 ding2 zyu6 tiu4 geng2
